# ACR OpsRoom - Full LLM Context & Architectural Specifications

## Overview
ACR OpsRoom is the 21st canonical ecosystem repository of Agentic Chat Rooms. It delivers an autonomous operations war room that supersedes Salesforce Agentforce and Slack AI by combining:
1. Atlas 2.0 Goal-Directed DAG Planning
2. Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) Quorum Consensus
3. ToolHive-Inspired Zero-Trust Process Sandboxing
4. Live Collaborative Ops Canvases with Merkle Tree Integrity
5. Synthetic Multi-Agent Huddles with Audio Equalizer Fabric
6. Statistical Anomaly Detection & ML Routing (/ml-best-practices)

## Mathematical Consensus Model
An operational squad of n agents evaluates mitigation proposals. Each agent casts a signed ballot:
- Approved if weighted approvals / (weighted approvals + weighted rejections) >= 0.67.
- Minimum absolute headcount >= ceil(n / 2).
- Zero unresolved Byzantine anomalies (tampered DID, corrupted confidence score, inverted rationale).
- Critical mutations trigger Human-In-The-Loop (HITL) dual-consent gating.

## Port Map
- 30447: Web Application (Vite + React 19 + GSAP + Canvas Shader)
- 20447: Backend REST & Server-Sent Events (SSE) Server
- 20445: acr-meta-mcp Forward Proxy & Multi-Cipher Vault
- 20443: acr-core Reference Daemon & NATS JetStream

## Verification Discipline
- Run `npm test` to execute the Node.js test suite across core and server packages.
- Run `npm run build` to build TypeScript packages and Vite web bundle.
